import os
base='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687614/attempts/bd404c7f247c4b47824543a2b5d1e349/system/state/workspace'; os.makedirs(base+'/programs',exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    # Copy the non-background pattern from the last compartment into every
    # compartment separated by full-width/full-height divider lines.
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    bg=max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda x:sum(r.count(x) for r in grid))
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    rs=[i for i,row in enumerate(g) if all(v!=bg for v in row)]
    cs=[j for j in range(W) if all(g[i][j]!=bg for i in range(H))]
    rb=[-1]+rs+[H]; cb=[-1]+cs+[W]
    rowspans=[(rb[k]+1,rb[k+1]) for k in range(len(rb)-1)]
    colspans=[(cb[k]+1,cb[k+1]) for k in range(len(cb)-1)]
    sr0,sr1=rowspans[-1]; sc0,sc1=colspans[-1]
    pattern=[row[sc0:sc1] for row in grid[sr0:sr1]]
    for r0,r1 in rowspans:
        for c0,c1 in colspans:
            if (r0,r1)==(sr0,sr1) and (c0,c1)==(sc0,sc1): continue
            for i in range(r1-r0):
                for j in range(c1-c0):
                    g[r0+i][c0+j]=pattern[i][j]
    return g
'''
open(base+'/programs/task-a47890f1.py','w').write(code)
exec(code)
